name: prototype
description: Build throwaway prototypes. Duplicate existing components, wire to variant switcher.

steps.name: Detect prototype branch
steps.instruction: Select branch: Logic (TUI/CLI for functional validation), UI (duplicate components + variant switcher), Design (token toggle panel). For Design: load design-sensibility.md.

steps.name: Scaffold prototype
steps.instruction: Never create standalone artifacts. UI: duplicate existing component(s), wire variant switcher for toggling original vs N variants in actual app layout. Logic: throwaway script/TUI. Design: toggle panel with token overrides.

steps.name: Iterate and compare
steps.instruction: Build meaningfully different variations (structural, not just color). Compare via variant switcher. Evaluate each against all 9 interaction states. Test dense/narrow/empty/error layouts. When writing code that enforces an invariant, constraint, or business rule, add a single-line comment at the relevant code line. Format: # Invariant: <desc> | # Constraint: <desc> | # Rule: <desc> | # Correction: <desc>.
checklist: Interaction states and edge layouts tested

steps.name: Extract or discard
steps.instruction: Chosen variant: extract as new implementation, remove switcher and other variants. Learning goal: discard all, document findings. Clean up.
checklist: Chosen variant extracted or all discarded

tone: Fast and rough. Prototypes validate ideas, not ship code.
